lines.t: Woke up with a lighter heart today
Something in me’s changed
All the weight I used to carry

You remind me who I am
Every time I call Your name
Now I’m walking in Your freedom
And I’ll never be the same
I don’t have to have it figured out
I just lift my hands and let it all fall down
I’m falling into You, Lord
I’m falling into Your love, Lord
I’m letting go of all my troubles
Letting go of this world
Now I’m coming straight to You, Lord
Yeah, I’m coming straight to You
So grab me when I fall into You
And hold me close
‘Cause all I wanna feel is You
Lord, I’m falling into You
